Authoritative, audited figures.

## Current Liabilities Portion of Long-term Debt

To determine the portion of the long-term debt reported as current liabilities as of December 31, 2007, we need to look at the long-term debt (2008) figure, which represents the portion due within the next year.

- **Long-term debt (2008)**: $272,014 thousand
- **Total long-term debt**: $4,275,397 thousand

\[ \text{Portion} = \frac{\text{Long-term debt (2008)}}{\text{Total long-term debt}} = \frac{272,014}{4,275,397} \approx 0.0636 \]

This means approximately 6.36% of the long-term debt is reported as current liabilities as of December 31, 2007.

(Source: [FIS fiscal 2007 annual report, page 52](documents/report.md))
